blocks.html: The provisions of Sections 3103.1 through 3103.4 shall apply to temporary tents, grandstands, platforms, reviewing stands, outdoor bandstands, stages and similar miscellaneous structures erected for a period of 90 days or less. Such structures may be constructed of wood whether located inside or outside of the fire districts.
